title: LEGACY MISROUTE: real Eclipse Bridge capture 001 through the CaseView parser, the lane today's first-byte detection picks for it
covers: KEPT ON PURPOSE as an explicit legacy-misroute corpus: IngestSessionWorker.feed decides the protocol from the first fed byte (chunk[0] === 0x02), and this stream's first byte after the login is 0x20, so production parses this Bridge stream as CaseView today. Its correct replay is bridge-tcp-001. libs/feed-parse detectProtocol routes it to Bridge, and the gate checks that it does; once the ingest is wired to detectProtocol, production stops producing this output
the CaseView parser on real Eclipse bytes (there is no real CaseView capture yet); the output is not a correct transcript
control bytes, 0x0C inside T data and long multi-command chunks in the CaseView byte loop
